causes: Player yaw follows the target every fixed step and previously determined dodge movement too, so crossing the target reversed the ongoing dodge repeatedly.

implementation: Choose dodge direction once at entry: explicit movement vector, otherwise backwards from facing. Camera-facing updates no longer reverse the movement.
Interpolate camera azimuth by the shortest arc and radius around a smoothed focus, keeping horizontal standoff during direction changes.
Use actor-facing direction for a coincident target; expose read-only rendered camera aggregates and assert meaningful geometric regressions in real browser missions.
